## Overview

|---|---|

| Node ID | `5299:6235` |
| Type | COMPONENT (symbol) |

Desktop variant of the same `Theme` component as the mobile DBU frame (`theme=nb/mb mobile` → DBU state, documented in `dbu-bg-layers.md` / `dbu-bg-standalone.md`). Full node also contains a `Content` frame (empty container, no children returned) — this doc focuses on the **BG + White Gradient + Pattern** layers, matching the scope of the other files in this folder.

Structure pulled directly from Figma `get_metadata` on the symbol (`5299:6235`).

Compared to the mobile DBU BG: **no `"Moving bg animation"` layer or hidden alternates here** — the desktop variant's Pattern is built from 4 tiled `Pattern` instances (instead of 1) covering the larger canvas, and `White Gradient` is visible (not hidden, unlike mobile where it's hidden).

## Animation / Motion

Checked Figma's motion/keyframe API on this node, recursive — **no native keyframe or Smart Animate motion data returned** (empty result).

Unlike the mobile DBU frame, this desktop tree has **no layer named after animation** and no hidden sibling alternates — no signal of an intended motion state here. If the desktop view is meant to move too, it's likely driven by the same prototype interaction as mobile, applied at the component level (check the `Theme` component's Prototype tab, not this specific instance).

## Notes

- 3 large blurred gradient ellipses (blue/purple orbs, same family as mobile: Ellipse 6391/6392/6393) + 4 tiled wavy-line `Pattern` instances + a white gradient overlay.
- Background image is embedded inline (base64) — this file is self-contained.
